<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918872_theRebbe_254" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918872_theRebbe_254__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>It explains that the raising of the lamps, revealing the soul's ratzo ascent, is specifically through Aharon, who embodies the Torah's halachos, which illuminate this ascent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it is explained in the discourses,</t>
    <t s="1">that the reason for the raising of the lamps</t>
    <t s="2">[the revelation of the nature of ratzo and the ascent of the souls]</t>
    <t s="3">is specifically through Aharon,</t>
    <t s="4">for regarding Aharon it is written,</t>
    <t s="5">"Like the good oil upon the head, descending upon the beard, the beard of Aharon, descending upon the opening of his garments,"</t>
    <t s="6">and the concept of the "beard of Aharon" is the halachos of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">and through the Torah,</t>
    <t s="8">"Torah is light,"</t>
    <t s="9">the nature of the soul's ascent</t>
    <t s="10">(which exists even during its descent below and its enclothing in the body)</t>
    <t s="11">is revealed and illuminated, "when you raise the lamps."</t>
    <t s="12">And based on this, we can explain the connection of the Sages' statement</t>
    <t s="13">(cited in the maamar)</t>
    <t s="14">"If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp" to "when you raise the lamps,"</t>
    <t s="15">for the concept of "I will guard your lamp"</t>
    <t s="16">(guarding the lamp so it will not be extinguished)</t>
    <t s="17">is that the lamp of the soul</t>
    <t s="18">(the nature of its ratzo and ascent)</t>
    <t s="19">will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="20">and this guarding of the soul's lamp is through guarding the lamp of Torah, analogous to the concept of "when you raise the lamps" which is through Aharon,</t>
    <t s="21">Torah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The maamar explains that the statement "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp" is understood through a Midrash showing that the world was created for Israel, whose perfection is through Torah, and that by fulfilling the 613 mitzvos the soul ascends higher than before its descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="2">that we need to understand regarding "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp,"</t>
    <t s="3">what is the connection between them, and moreover that they are dependent on each other.</t>
    <t s="4">And it explains this based on what is stated in the Midrash,</t>
    <t s="5">"In whose merit were 'These are the generations of the heavens and the earth' created?"</t>
    <t s="6">"And in whose merit do they stand?"</t>
    <t s="7">"In the merit of 'These are the names of the children of Israel,'"</t>
    <t s="8">"And these, in whose merit do they stand?"</t>
    <t s="9">"In the merit of 'These are the testimonies, statutes, and judgments.'"</t>
    <t s="10">That the intent is that the creation of the world is for the sake of Israel,</t>
    <t s="11">and the perfection of Israel is through the Torah.</t>
    <t s="12">For through Israel fulfilling the 613 mitzvos, they ascend to a higher level than they are in their own right.</t>
    <t s="13">And this is why the soul descends below and becomes enclothed in a physical body in order to fulfill Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="14">for through the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos, the soul ascends higher than it was before its descent.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp,"</t>
    <t s="16">that the guarding of the soul's lamp is through guarding the lamp of Torah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>It connects the concept of the soul's ascent through Torah and mitzvos to a higher level than before its descent with the theme of "when you raise the lamps."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on what is written in the maamar, that the concept of "If you have guarded My lamp, I will guard your lamp" is that through fulfilling Torah and mitzvos the soul ascends higher than it was before its descent,</t>
    <t s="1">one can say,</t>
    <t s="2">that this connection of this concept with "when you raise the lamps,"</t>
    <t s="3">is,</t>
    <t s="4">for also the concept of "when you raise the lamps" is</t>
    <t s="5">the ascent that occurs in the souls to a level higher even than they were before their descent below.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
